question: Which employee has been in the Engineering Department the longest? Please give his or her firstname and lastname.

question: Which month has the highest turnover in each year
SQL: SELECT strftime('%Y', t.TransactionDate) AS Year, strftime('%m', t.TransactionDate) AS Month, SUM(t.Quantity) AS TotalVolume FROM TransactionHistory t GROUP BY Year, Month HAVING TotalVolume = ( SELECT MAX(monthly_sum) FROM ( SELECT SUM(Quantity) AS monthly_sum FROM TransactionHistory t2 WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.TransactionDate) = strftime('%Y', t.TransactionDate) GROUP BY strftime('%m', t2.TransactionDate) ) ) ORDER BY Year, Month;
cypher:
MATCH (t:TransactionHistory)
WITH left(t.TransactionDate, 4) AS Year,
     substring(t.TransactionDate, 5, 2) AS Month,
     SUM(t.Quantity) AS TotalVolume
WITH Year,
     collect({Month: Month, TotalVolume: TotalVolume}) AS monthlyRows,
     max(TotalVolume) AS maxMonthlyVolume
UNWIND monthlyRows AS row
WITH Year,
     row.Month AS Month,
     row.TotalVolume AS TotalVolume,
     maxMonthlyVolume
WHERE TotalVolume = maxMonthlyVolume
RETURN Year AS Year,
       Month AS Month,
       TotalVolume AS TotalVolume
ORDER BY Year, Month

question: Which products experienced a month-over-month increase in total transaction quantity, and what was the exact volume of that increase for each specific growth month?
SQL: SELECT ProductID, Month, Qty, PrevQty, (Qty - PrevQty) AS IncreaseAmount FROM ( SELECT ProductID, strftime('%Y-%m', TransactionDate) AS Month, SUM(Quantity) AS Qty, LAG(SUM(Quantity)) OVER ( PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', TransactionDate) ) AS PrevQty FROM TransactionHistory GROUP BY ProductID, Month ) t WHERE PrevQty IS NOT NULL AND Qty > PrevQty;
cypher:
MATCH (th:TransactionHistory)
WITH th.ProductID AS ProductID,
     left(th.TransactionDate, 7) AS Month,
     SUM(th.Quantity) AS Qty
ORDER BY ProductID, Month
WITH ProductID,
     collect({Month: Month, Qty: Qty}) AS monthlyRows
WHERE size(monthlyRows) > 1
UNWIND range(1, size(monthlyRows) - 1) AS i
WITH ProductID,
     monthlyRows[i].Month AS Month,
     monthlyRows[i].Qty AS Qty,
     monthlyRows[i - 1].Qty AS PrevQty
WHERE PrevQty IS NOT NULL
  AND Qty > PrevQty
RETURN ProductID AS ProductID,
       Month AS Month,
       Qty AS Qty,
       PrevQty AS PrevQty,
       Qty - PrevQty AS IncreaseAmount
ORDER BY ProductID, Month

question: How does total production change month-over-month?

WITH left(wo.StartDate, 7) AS Month,
     SUM(wo.OrderQty) AS TotalQty
ORDER BY Month
WITH collect({Month: Month, TotalQty: TotalQty}) AS monthlyRows

WITH monthlyRows[i].Month AS Month,
     monthlyRows[i].TotalQty AS TotalQty,

       TotalQty - PrevMonthQty AS Growth

     sum(wo.StockedQty) AS TotalStocked,

question: Rank territories by sales year-to-date within each territory group.

question: Return the top 3 highest-value orders for each salesperson, using order total due to rank orders within each salesperson.

WHERE h.SalesPersonID IS NOT NULL
WITH h
ORDER BY h.SalesPersonID, h.TotalDue DESC, h.SalesOrderID

     collect({

question: Can you categorize each product-vendor combo by quality? label them as Perfect, Good, Moderate, High Risk, or No Receipts.
SQL: WITH RejectionRate AS ( SELECT ProductID, SUM(RejectedQty) / NULLIF(SUM(ReceivedQty), 0) AS RejRate FROM PurchaseOrderDetail GROUP BY ProductID ) SELECT pv.ProductID, v.Name AS VendorName, pv.StandardPrice, rr.RejRate, CASE WHEN rr.RejRate IS NULL THEN 'No Receipts' WHEN rr.RejRate = 0 THEN 'Perfect' WHEN rr.RejRate < 0.05 THEN 'Good' WHEN rr.RejRate < 0.15 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'High Risk' END AS QualityCategory FROM ProductVendor pv JOIN Vendor v ON v.BusinessEntityID = pv.BusinessEntityID LEFT JOIN RejectionRate rr ON rr.ProductID = pv.ProductID ORDER BY rr.RejRate DESC NULLS LAST;
cypher:
MATCH (pod:PurchaseOrderDetail)
WITH pod.ProductID AS ProductID,
     SUM(pod.RejectedQty) AS TotalRejected,
     SUM(pod.ReceivedQty) AS TotalReceived
WITH ProductID,
     CASE
         WHEN TotalReceived = 0 THEN null
         ELSE TotalRejected / TotalReceived
     END AS RejRate

WITH collect({
    ProductID: ProductID,
    RejRate: RejRate
}) AS rejectionRows

MATCH (pv:ProductVendor), (v:Vendor)
WHERE v.BusinessEntityID = pv.BusinessEntityID

WITH pv,
     v,
     [r IN rejectionRows WHERE r.ProductID = pv.ProductID][0] AS rr

WITH pv.ProductID AS ProductID,
     v.Name AS VendorName,
     pv.StandardPrice AS StandardPrice,
     rr.RejRate AS RejRate,
     CASE
         WHEN rr.RejRate IS NULL THEN 'No Receipts'
         WHEN rr.RejRate = 0 THEN 'Perfect'
         WHEN rr.RejRate < 0.05 THEN 'Good'
         WHEN rr.RejRate < 0.15 THEN 'Moderate'
         ELSE 'High Risk'
     END AS QualityCategory

RETURN ProductID AS ProductID,
       VendorName AS VendorName,
       StandardPrice AS StandardPrice,
       RejRate AS RejRate,
       QualityCategory AS QualityCategory
ORDER BY RejRate IS NULL ASC, RejRate DESC

question: What category and subcategory does each product belong to?
SQL: SELECT p.Name AS Product, ps.Name AS Subcategory, pc.Name AS Category FROM Product p JOIN ProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID JOIN ProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID ORDER BY pc.Name, ps.Name, p.Name;
cypher:
MATCH (p:Product), (ps:ProductSubcategory), (pc:ProductCategory)
WHERE p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID
  AND ps.ProductCategoryID = pc.ProductCategoryID
RETURN p.Name AS Product,
       ps.Name AS Subcategory,
       pc.Name AS Category
ORDER BY Category, Subcategory, Product

question: What is the average customer rating for each reviewed product?
SQL: SELECT p.Name AS Product, ROUND(AVG(pr.Rating), 2) AS AvgRating, COUNT(pr.ProductReviewID) AS ReviewCount FROM Product p JOIN ProductReview pr ON p.ProductID = pr.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Name ORDER BY AvgRating DESC;
cypher:
MATCH (pr:ProductReview)-[:REVIEW_OF]->(p:Product)
WITH p.ProductID AS ProductID,
     p.Name AS Product,
     round(AVG(pr.Rating), 2) AS AvgRating,
     COUNT(pr.ProductReviewID) AS ReviewCount
RETURN Product AS Product,
       AvgRating AS AvgRating,
       ReviewCount AS ReviewCount
ORDER BY AvgRating DESC

question: Which department and shift is each employee currently assigned to?
SQL: SELECT p.FirstName || ' ' || p.LastName AS Employee, d.Name AS Department, s.Name AS Shift FROM Employee e JOIN Person p ON e.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID JOIN EmployeeDepartmentHistory edh ON e.BusinessEntityID = edh.BusinessEntityID JOIN Department d ON edh.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID JOIN Shift s ON edh.ShiftID = s.ShiftID WHERE edh.EndDate IS NULL ORDER BY d.Name, Employee;
cypher:
MATCH (e:Employee), (p:Person), (edh:EmployeeDepartmentHistory), (d:Department), (s:Shift)
WHERE e.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID
  AND e.BusinessEntityID = edh.BusinessEntityID
  AND edh.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID
  AND edh.ShiftID = s.ShiftID
  AND edh.EndDate IS NULL
RETURN p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName AS Employee,
       d.Name AS Department,
       s.Name AS Shift
ORDER BY Department, Employee

question: How many orders were placed and what was the total revenue each month?
SQL: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount, ROUND(SUM(TotalDue), 2) AS TotalRevenue FROM SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month;
cypher:
MATCH (soh:SalesOrderHeader)
// Step 1: Extract Year-Month string from the OrderDate
WITH left(soh.OrderDate, 7) AS Month, 
     soh.TotalDue AS TotalDue
// Step 2: Group by Month and perform aggregations
WITH Month, 
     count(*) AS OrderCount, 
     sum(TotalDue) AS RawRevenue
RETURN Month, 
       OrderCount, 
       round(RawRevenue * 100) / 100 AS TotalRevenue
ORDER BY Month ASC

question: Which vendors supply each product and at what standard price?
SQL: SELECT p.Name AS Product, v.Name AS Vendor, pv.StandardPrice, pv.AverageLeadTime FROM ProductVendor pv JOIN Product p ON pv.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Vendor v ON pv.BusinessEntityID = v.BusinessEntityID ORDER BY p.Name, pv.StandardPrice;
cypher:
MATCH (pv:ProductVendor), (p:Product), (v:Vendor)
WHERE pv.ProductID = p.ProductID
  AND pv.BusinessEntityID = v.BusinessEntityID
RETURN p.Name AS Product,
       v.Name AS Vendor,
       pv.StandardPrice AS StandardPrice,
       pv.AverageLeadTime AS AverageLeadTime

question: What are the top 10 products by revenue and what percentage of overall sales does each represent?
SQL: SELECT p.Name AS Product, ROUND(SUM(sod.LineTotal), 2) AS ProductRevenue, ROUND(SUM(sod.LineTotal) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(LineTotal) FROM SalesOrderDetail), 2) AS RevenueSharePct FROM SalesOrderDetail sod JOIN Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Name ORDER BY ProductRevenue DESC LIMIT 10;
cypher:
CALL {
    MATCH (sod2:SalesOrderDetail)
    RETURN SUM(sod2.LineTotal) AS totalRevenue
}
MATCH (sod:SalesOrderDetail), (p:Product)
WHERE sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
WITH p.ProductID AS ProductID,
     p.Name AS Product,
     round(SUM(sod.LineTotal), 2) AS ProductRevenue,
     totalRevenue
RETURN Product AS Product,
       ProductRevenue AS ProductRevenue,
       round(ProductRevenue * 100.0 / totalRevenue, 2) AS RevenueSharePct
ORDER BY ProductRevenue DESC
LIMIT 10

question: What is the pay rate change history for each employee showing percentage change between consecutive rates?
SQL: SELECT p.FirstName || ' ' || p.LastName AS Employee, eph.RateChangeDate, eph.Rate, LAG(eph.Rate) OVER (PARTITION BY eph.BusinessEntityID ORDER BY eph.RateChangeDate) AS PreviousRate, ROUND((eph.Rate - LAG(eph.Rate) OVER (PARTITION BY eph.BusinessEntityID ORDER BY eph.RateChangeDate)) / LAG(eph.Rate) OVER (PARTITION BY eph.BusinessEntityID ORDER BY eph.RateChangeDate) * 100, 2) AS PctChange FROM EmployeePayHistory eph JOIN Person p ON eph.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID ORDER BY Employee, eph.RateChangeDate;
cypher:
MATCH (eph:EmployeePayHistory), (p:Person)
WHERE eph.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID
WITH eph.BusinessEntityID AS BusinessEntityID,
     p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName AS Employee,
     eph.RateChangeDate AS RateChangeDate,
     eph.Rate AS Rate
ORDER BY BusinessEntityID, RateChangeDate
WITH BusinessEntityID,
     Employee,
     collect({
         RateChangeDate: RateChangeDate,
         Rate: Rate
     }) AS rateRows
UNWIND range(0, size(rateRows) - 1) AS i
WITH Employee,
     rateRows[i].RateChangeDate AS RateChangeDate,
     rateRows[i].Rate AS Rate,
     CASE
         WHEN i = 0 THEN null
         ELSE rateRows[i - 1].Rate
     END AS PreviousRate
RETURN Employee AS Employee,
       RateChangeDate AS RateChangeDate,
       Rate AS Rate,
       PreviousRate AS PreviousRate,
       CASE
           WHEN PreviousRate IS NULL THEN null
           ELSE round(((Rate - PreviousRate) / PreviousRate) * 100, 2)
       END AS PctChange
ORDER BY Employee, RateChangeDate

question: Which customers have only placed in-store orders and never ordered online?
SQL: SELECT p.FirstName || ' ' || p.LastName AS CustomerName, COUNT(soh.SalesOrderID) AS TotalOrders FROM Customer c JOIN Person p ON c.PersonID = p.BusinessEntityID JOIN SalesOrderHeader soh ON c.CustomerID = soh.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, CustomerName HAVING MAX(soh.OnlineOrderFlag) = 0 ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC;
cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:IS_CUSTOMER_OF]->(c:Customer)-[:PLACED_ORDER]->(soh:SalesOrderHeader)
WITH p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName AS CustomerName, 
     c.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
     collect(soh.OnlineOrderFlag) AS OrderFlags,
     count(soh) AS TotalOrders
// Filter for customers where NONE of their orders have OnlineOrderFlag = 1
WHERE all(flag IN OrderFlags WHERE flag = 0)
RETURN CustomerName, 
       TotalOrders
ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC

question: Which products have the highest scrap rates in work orders and what are the top scrap reasons?
SQL: SELECT p.Name AS Product, sr.Name AS ScrapReason, SUM(wo.ScrappedQty) AS TotalScrapped, SUM(wo.OrderQty) AS TotalOrdered, ROUND(SUM(wo.ScrappedQty) * 100.0 / SUM(wo.OrderQty), 2) AS ScrapRatePct FROM WorkOrder wo JOIN Product p ON wo.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN ScrapReason sr ON wo.ScrapReasonID = sr.ScrapReasonID WHERE wo.ScrapReasonID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Name, sr.ScrapReasonID, sr.Name ORDER BY ScrapRatePct DESC LIMIT 10;
cypher:
MATCH (wo:WorkOrder), (p:Product), (sr:ScrapReason)
WHERE wo.ProductID = p.ProductID
  AND wo.ScrapReasonID = sr.ScrapReasonID
  AND wo.ScrapReasonID IS NOT NULL
WITH p.ProductID AS ProductID,
     p.Name AS Product,
     sr.ScrapReasonID AS ScrapReasonID,
     sr.Name AS ScrapReason,
     SUM(wo.ScrappedQty) AS TotalScrapped,
     SUM(wo.OrderQty) AS TotalOrdered
RETURN Product AS Product,
       ScrapReason AS ScrapReason,
       TotalScrapped AS TotalScrapped,
       TotalOrdered AS TotalOrdered,
       round(toFloat(TotalScrapped) * 100.0 / TotalOrdered, 2) AS ScrapRatePct
ORDER BY ScrapRatePct DESC
LIMIT 10

question: How do each salesperson's year-to-date sales compare to their quota and what is the achievement percentage?
SQL: SELECT p.FirstName || ' ' || p.LastName AS SalesPerson, st.Name AS Territory, ROUND(sp.SalesQuota, 2) AS SalesQuota, ROUND(sp.SalesYTD, 2) AS SalesYTD, CASE WHEN sp.SalesQuota > 0 THEN ROUND(sp.SalesYTD * 100.0 / sp.SalesQuota, 2) ELSE NULL END AS QuotaAchievementPct FROM SalesPerson sp JOIN Person p ON sp.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID LEFT JOIN SalesTerritory st ON sp.TerritoryID = st.TerritoryID ORDER BY QuotaAchievementPct DESC;
cypher:
MATCH (sp:SalesPerson), (p:Person)
WHERE sp.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID
OPTIONAL MATCH (st:SalesTerritory)
WHERE sp.TerritoryID = st.TerritoryID
WITH p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName AS SalesPerson,
     st.Name AS Territory,
     round(sp.SalesQuota, 2) AS SalesQuota,
     round(sp.SalesYTD, 2) AS SalesYTD,
     CASE
         WHEN sp.SalesQuota > 0
             THEN round(sp.SalesYTD * 100.0 / sp.SalesQuota, 2)
         ELSE null
     END AS QuotaAchievementPct
RETURN SalesPerson AS SalesPerson,
       Territory AS Territory,
       SalesQuota AS SalesQuota,
       SalesYTD AS SalesYTD,
       QuotaAchievementPct AS QuotaAchievementPct
ORDER BY QuotaAchievementPct IS NULL ASC, QuotaAchievementPct DESC

question: Which products need immediate restocking based on current inventory levels reorder points and outstanding purchase orders?
SQL: SELECT p.Name AS Product, p.ReorderPoint, COALESCE(inv.TotalStock, 0) AS CurrentStock, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pod2.OrderQty - pod2.ReceivedQty) FROM PurchaseOrderDetail pod2 WHERE pod2.ProductID = p.ProductID AND pod2.ReceivedQty < pod2.OrderQty), 0) AS PendingOrderQty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.TotalStock, 0) < p.ReorderPoint AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pod2.OrderQty - pod2.ReceivedQty) FROM PurchaseOrderDetail pod2 WHERE pod2.ProductID = p.ProductID AND pod2.ReceivedQty < pod2.OrderQty), 0) = 0 THEN 'Immediate Restock Needed' WHEN COALESCE(inv.TotalStock, 0) < p.ReorderPoint THEN 'Low Stock - Order Pending' ELSE 'Stock OK' END AS StockStatus FROM Product p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductID, SUM(Quantity) AS TotalStock FROM ProductInventory GROUP BY ProductID) inv ON p.ProductID = inv.ProductID WHERE StockStatus != 'Stock OK' ORDER BY CurrentStock ASC;
cypher:
MATCH (p:Product)

OPTIONAL MATCH (inv:ProductInventory)
WHERE inv.ProductID = p.ProductID
WITH p,
     coalesce(SUM(inv.Quantity), 0) AS CurrentStock

OPTIONAL MATCH (pod2:PurchaseOrderDetail)
WHERE pod2.ProductID = p.ProductID
  AND pod2.ReceivedQty < pod2.OrderQty
WITH p,
     CurrentStock,
     coalesce(SUM(pod2.OrderQty - pod2.ReceivedQty), 0) AS PendingOrderQty

WITH p.Name AS Product,
     p.ReorderPoint AS ReorderPoint,
     CurrentStock,
     PendingOrderQty,
     CASE
         WHEN CurrentStock < p.ReorderPoint AND PendingOrderQty = 0
             THEN 'Immediate Restock Needed'
         WHEN CurrentStock < p.ReorderPoint
             THEN 'Low Stock - Order Pending'
         ELSE 'Stock OK'
     END AS StockStatus

WHERE StockStatus <> 'Stock OK'

RETURN Product AS Product,
       ReorderPoint AS ReorderPoint,
       CurrentStock AS CurrentStock,
       PendingOrderQty AS PendingOrderQty,
       StockStatus AS StockStatus
ORDER BY CurrentStock ASC
